notes: Web 389 — sessionFacts miles fallback (BUBBLE-KM-MISSING-IN-HANDS-NOV9, the named web-side residual; owner Nov 9, 2026, 10:05 CST screenshot on gen 65: the widget read 16.7 km while the bubble, composing from the native SessionRecord alone, showed loads and NO km). The mechanism: sessionFacts took the session's miles ONLY from LiveMiles.recordKmFor('s' + sessionId) — the PERSISTED record for the session key. That record held no fix-backed total all day Nov 9, so recordKmFor returned null, the facts carried milesM -1, and every sync landed 'unknown' on the native record — while the page's live engine held the day's km (the hero painted 16.6/16.7 from LiveMiles.currentKm()) and the widget showed km off its web-pushed string that the record never held. Fix, js/app.js ONLY (sessionFacts): when recordKmFor(sessionKey) yields no total, fall back to the active day's fix-backed ENGINE total — LiveMiles.currentKm(), the very total the tracker hero paints — so the facts carry the km the page itself displays. A landed recordKmFor total always wins, 0 included; with no fix-backed total in either source the miles stay unset (-1): no number is invented. recordKmFor itself is NOT changed — its keyed contract serves the stop-time and finalize readers, which must never inherit the live engine's day. (The companion guard — an incoming unknown milesM never erasing a landed total in SessionRecord.syncFromWeb — rides the native gen-67 pass, as spec'd by the bench.)
